description: Send an SMS through YOUR connected Telnyx or Twilio account (bring your own carrier). The provider bills you for the SMS; mot adds a flat rail fee per message. Needs trust level Z1 or higher and a line key. Returns the provider message id; delivery updates arrive as sms.status events.

from.description: Sender number on your account. Omit to use the default saved with the credential.

provider.description: Which of your connected accounts to use. Omit to use the tested one (or the newest).

to.description: Recipient in E.164. Z1 reaches the USA and Canada; Z2 reaches international numbers.

name: sms_send
